boundary_rule: A transaction at a boundary belongs to the later split; tied timestamps stay together.
duplicate_policy: Retain all source rows. Report primary metrics on all evaluation rows and sensitivity metrics excluding V1–V28/Amount vectors observed in earlier splits.
evaluation_exposure: Full-dataset label-aware EDA preceded this protocol. Evaluation is reserved from subsequent fitting/tuning, but is not an untouched analytical holdout.
label_availability: Historical replay assumes earlier-window labels are available for fitting. Actual label delays are unknown; do not claim this demonstrates a deployable retraining cadence.
